name: Wilder Thistlenettle
summary: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Wilder Thistlenettle drinks alone with old grief. He once entered Moonbrook’s Deadmines with his brother and their mining crew, but a cave-in left him the sole survivor.

sections.title: A Bitter Survivor
sections.body: Wilder Thistlenettle drinks away his sorrow in an alehouse near the Dwarven District’s southeastern gates. Years ago, he joined his brother and their companions in the deep lodes of Moonbrook’s Deadmines. A cave-in sealed the rest of the crew underground, and Wilder barely reached the surface alive.

sections.title: Ghosts of the Deep
sections.body: Wilder’s brother and the lost mining company haunt the Deadmines as restless undead. Dark magic or unfinished business keeps them bound to the subterranean ruins. Grief and guilt weigh on Wilder, who asks travelers bound for the mines to recover mementos of the fallen and bring his brother peace.

faq.q: Where can I find Wilder Thistlenettle?
faq.answer: Wilder sits inside a quiet pub in Stormwind City’s Dwarven District, just inside the right side of its southeastern entrance.

faq.q: What happened to his brother in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: A sudden tunnel collapse trapped Wilder’s brother with the other miners. Wilder escaped and seeks news of those left below.
Wilder asks travelers entering the Deadmines to recover personal mining union badges from the lost workers and investigate what happened to his brother.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Wilder’s grief recalls the dangers of deep delving and the duty to honor fallen guild brothers.
As a miner, you know unstable earth can entomb even seasoned crews deep underground.
